## Requirements

- Add a search endpoint at `/api/v1/equipment/search` that supports full-text search on equipment name and model number
- Support filtering by: equipment type, manufacturer, installation date range, and active/inactive status
- Results should be paginated (default 25 per page) with cursor-based pagination
- Include total count in response metadata
- Search should be case-insensitive
- Empty search with no filters returns all equipment for the tenant, paginated
